Concept Font Symbols
Generic base ring Latin cap R — an arbitrary ring carrying the least structure the construction needs (a commutative ring; a field when inverses are taken; a group with zero for negative powers q^{-k}). Default for all categorical / algebraic / q-deformation / Wenzl–Hecke–Hoefsmit structural data.
Archimedean base ring blackboard bold \mathbb{R} — used only past the archimedean wall: any construction that genuinely needs square roots, real powers, \cos, \exp, \log, an ordering (0 < q), or a CODATA / experimental numerical value. Narrative side: q \in R when only the algebraic structure matters; q \in \mathbb{R} only for archimedean evaluation (e.g. q_0 = 1.109978595642739\ldots (muon pin, 16 dps)).
